name: Research
description: Provides access to the research service feature of Microsoft Word.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Word application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the add-in was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns an Object that represents the parent object of the specified Research object.

properties.name: FavoriteService
properties.description: Returns or sets a String that specifies the favorite research service.

methods.name: Query
methods.signature: Query(ServiceID As String, [QueryString As String], [QueryLanguage As WdLanguageID], [UseSelection As Boolean], [LaunchQuery As Boolean]) As Variant

parameters.name: ServiceID
parameters.description: Specifies a GUID that identifies the research service.

parameters.name: QueryLanguage
parameters.description: Specifies the query language of the query string.

parameters.name: UseSelection
parameters.description: True to use the current selection as the query string. This overrides the QueryString parameter if set. Default value is False.

parameters.name: LaunchQuery
parameters.description: True launches the query. False displays the Research task pane scoped to search the specified research service.

methods.name: SetLanguagePair
methods.signature: SetLanguagePair(LanguageFrom As WdLanguageID, LanguageTo As WdLanguageID) As Variant
methods.description: Sets the languages for the translation service.

parameters.name: LanguageFrom
parameters.description: Specifies the language to translate from.

parameters.name: LanguageTo
parameters.description: Specifies the language to translate to.

methods.name: IsResearchService
methods.description: Indicates whether the GUID specified in the ServiceID parameter corresponds to a currently configured service.

parameters.name: ServiceID
parameters.description: Specifies a GUID that identifies the research service.
